english.title: Premises licence holder fail to send licence to authority within 14 days of s.41 notice - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of the premises licence for **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), failed, without reasonable excuse, to forward to **(..SPECIFY THE LICENSING AUTHORITY..) within fourteen days of receipt of a copy of a notification under section 41(1) of the Licensing Act 2003, the premises licence, the appropriate part of the premises licence or a statement of the reasons for failure to provide the licence or part of the licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 41 of the Licensing Act 2003.
